subject: general
question: In which northeastern state was the Hornbill Festival held with record participation in December 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Hornbill Festival**, also known as the "Festival of Festivals," is an annual cultural festival celebrated in the state of **Nagaland**.
 
• It is held every year in the first week of December, typically from **December 1 to December 10**, to coincide with Nagaland's Statehood Day, which is celebrated on **1st December**.
 
• This festival is organized by the Government of Nagaland in **Kisama Heritage Village**, which is located about 12 km from Kohima, the state capital.
 
• In **December 2024**, the Hornbill Festival saw record-breaking participation from visitors across India and other countries, highlighting its growing popularity. *Hence, Nagaland is the correct answer.*
 
• The festival is a vibrant celebration of the rich cultural heritage, traditions, and tribal diversity of the people of Nagaland.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Key Highlights of the Hornbill Festival:**

 
 
• The festival is named after the **Hornbill bird**, which is considered a symbol of respect and cultural significance among the tribes of Nagaland.
 
• It showcases the **culture, dances, music, crafts, and food** of the 17 major tribes of Nagaland, along with many sub-tribes.
 
• Key activities include traditional dance performances, folk music, indigenous sports, art exhibitions, and a **rock music festival** that attracts bands from across the country and abroad.
 
• The festival also hosts a **night bazaar**, offering unique local crafts, handloom products, and traditional cuisine.
 
 
 
• **Kisama Heritage Village:**
 
 
• The venue of the Hornbill Festival, Kisama Heritage Village, is designed to represent the traditional houses and lifestyle of the Naga tribes.
 
• Each of the 17 major tribes of Nagaland has its own **morung (traditional hut)** in the village, showcasing their unique architectural styles and culture.
 
 
 
• **Tourism Impact:**
 
 
• The Hornbill Festival is a major tourist attraction, drawing visitors from across the world, and contributing significantly to the local economy.
 
• It provides a platform for the preservation and promotion of **Naga culture**, while also fostering unity among the diverse tribes of the state.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Importance of the Hornbill Festival:**

 
 
• It plays a vital role in preserving the **intangible cultural heritage** of Nagaland and promoting its unique identity.
 
• The festival fosters **unity** among the different tribes of Nagaland by providing a common platform to showcase their cultures.
 
• The event is supported by the central and state governments to boost **cultural tourism** in the northeastern region of India.
 
 
 
• **Other Festivals in Northeast India:**
 
 
• **Meghalaya:** The Wangala Festival is a major celebration of the Garo tribe, marking the end of the harvest season.
 
• **Manipur:** The Sangai Festival highlights the state's culture, heritage, and the endangered Sangai deer.
 
• **Assam:** The Bihu Festival is the most popular festival in Assam, celebrating the agricultural cycle and seasons.
